E2E in browser (390px) with Stripe test card 4242: guest Membership -> Silver 'Subscribe · $49/month' -> Stripe -> /payment-result shows 'Payment confirmed' (payment-status-paid). DB: level silver, subscription_status active, stripe_subscription_id + customer saved, membership_payments row created, tx status paid with no needs_refund. GET /api/membership/subscription returns active=true, status active, renews_at 2026-12-14, manageable=false. Membership screen shows subscription-card 'Silver · monthly / Renews automatically on Dec 14.' with subscription-manage-note, no toggle button, and Silver marked CURRENT. Gentleman trial E2E: sign-up Guest + Gentlemen + Bronze -> Stripe 'Try Nocturne Bronze · 7 days free' -> 'Start trial' with 4242 -> payment-status-paid ($0.00) -> subscription status trialing, trial_used=true, card 'Bronze · free trial / Free until Nov 21, then $14.99/month.' POST /membership/subscription/cancel in proxy mode returns 503 JSON with a readable message. No 502 is left in the backend. Ticket checkout prefills customer_email (verified on the Stripe session). Venues: the FEATURED pill sits top-left on the image, GOLD sits top-right, nothing overlaps and the rating is not clipped; Club Noire is listed first. The Profile Bank payouts subtitle reads 'Get your earnings sent to your bank'. Backend: test_nocturne_billing.py 33/33. Legacy suite (-n 0) 110/110 after one outdated test was fixed. Ticket counts are unchanged (all 0). No deprecated Expo packages detected. No SafeAreaView issues detected.

minor.issue: Replacing an older plan calls stripe.Subscription.cancel(old). The proxy has no /v1/subscriptions route, so the call fails and is only logged, and the old Stripe subscription stays active. In preview, a plan change leaves 2 live subscriptions (test mode only). The own key fixes this. Consider adding cancel_at_period_end=true to the old sub, or flagging it for admin, when not OWN_KEY.

sync_subscription_id returns early when not OWN_KEY, and level_paid_until is never enforced anywhere (server.py/features.py). In preview, a lapsed or cancelled sub never drops the user back to Bronze. Expected until the own key and webhook are set. Noting it as a production-readiness check.

The process env STRIPE_API_KEY is a publishable LIVE key (pk_live_...), not a secret key. stripe_core correctly treats it as not OWN_KEY and uses the proxy. The user should provide an sk_/rk_ key when they want own-account mode.

issues: A free trial shows 'Payment confirmed … $0.00'. 'Free trial started' would read better for trial checkouts (kind=membership and amount 0).

critical_code_review_comments: activate_subscription now uses checkout.Session.retrieve(expand=['subscription']) and works through the proxy. Verified end to end for both a paid sub (active) and a trial (trialing).
SubscriptionOut.manageable defaults to OWN_KEY, a module constant. This is fine because the key is static per process.
toggle_renewal checks for a missing plan (400) before proxy mode (503). That order is fine.
All HTTPException(502) were replaced with 503. Cancel returns application/json, so the detail reaches the app.
